plugins.description: Create and edit local Word, Excel and PowerPoint files.
plugins.author: Kiki

zh.description: 在本机创建、读取、编辑和预览 Word、Excel 与 PowerPoint 文件。

plugins.description: A focused manuscript panel and draft command.
plugins.author: Kiki

zh.description: 一个专注的手稿面板，以及一个按当前场景续写草稿的命令。

plugins.description: Turn local PDF, Office, HTML and text documents into readable Markdown with source metadata. MinerU OCR is explicit and opt-in.
plugins.author: Kiki

zh.description: 把本机的 PDF、Office、HTML 与文本文档转成可读的 Markdown，并保留来源信息。MinerU OCR 需你显式指定，不作为默认回退。

plugins.description: Search and read Notion material, produce source-backed briefs, and save to a specified page on request.
plugins.author: Kiki

zh.description: 检索并阅读 Notion 中的资料，产出带出处的简报，并可按你的要求写回指定页面。

plugins.description: The media surface: image, video and speech providers, their credentials, and the per-modality defaults. Install a provider package for each service you use.
plugins.author: Kiki

zh.description: 媒体生成入口：图像、视频与语音 provider、它们的凭据，以及各模态的默认设置。用到哪家的服务，就安装对应的 provider 包。

plugins.description: OpenAI image generation and editing, and file speech synthesis. Needs a media-capable API connection or key; cloud generation can incur charges.
plugins.author: Kiki

zh.description: OpenAI 图像生成与编辑，以及语音合成文件。需具备媒体权限的 API 连接或 key；云端生成可能产生费用。

plugins.description: Google Gemini native images and Veo asynchronous video. Needs the corresponding media API access.
plugins.author: Kiki

zh.description: Google Gemini 原生图像，以及异步生成的 Veo 视频。需对应的媒体 API 权限。

plugins.description: Ark Seedream images and the Seedance 2.0 video protocol. Configure an entitled endpoint and model; no implicit OSS upload and no Seedance 2.5.
plugins.author: Kiki

zh.description: Ark Seedream 图像与 Seedance 2.0 视频协议。需配置你有权使用的端点与模型；不会隐式上传素材，也不支持 Seedance 2.5。

plugins.description: xAI image generation and editing, and asynchronous video. API media access is required; a Grok web subscription is not assumed compatible.
plugins.author: Kiki

zh.description: xAI 图像生成与编辑，以及异步视频。需 API 媒体权限；不假定 Grok 网页订阅即可使用。

plugins.description: MiniMax portrait-reference images, H3 and H3-Max video, and HTTP/SSE file speech with optional subtitles. Needs media API access; long text is not split into paid jobs automatically.
plugins.author: Kiki

zh.description: MiniMax 人像参考图、H3 与 H3-Max 视频，以及带可选字幕的 HTTP/SSE 语音文件。需媒体 API 权限；超长文本不会自动拆分成多次付费任务。

plugins.description: StepFun HTTP binary and SSE file speech through a TTS-capable API endpoint. Not a WebSocket live-session runtime.
plugins.author: Kiki

zh.description: 通过支持 TTS 的 API 端点，以 HTTP 二进制或 SSE 合成语音文件。不是 WebSocket 实时语音运行时。

plugins.description: Optional Novita /video/create and task-result compatibility profile. Configure your endpoint and the actual model; not every Novita API is supported.
plugins.author: Kiki

zh.description: 可选的 Novita /video/create 与任务结果兼容配置。需配置你的端点与实际模型；并非 Novita API 的全部能力。

plugins.description: Optional Agnes 2.5, Flash and V2.0 video endpoint adapter with explicit frame and reference roles. Configure a compatible endpoint.
plugins.author: Kiki

zh.description: 可选的 Agnes 2.5、Flash 与 V2.0 视频端点适配，明确区分首帧与参考素材角色。需配置兼容端点。

plugins.description: Optional NewAPI /video/generations gateway profile. Model availability and audio generation depend on your configured endpoint.
plugins.author: Kiki

zh.description: 可选的 NewAPI /video/generations 网关配置。可用模型与是否生成音频，取决于你配置的端点。

plugins.description: Optional ComfyUI API-format image and video workflows using your running endpoint and installed models. No engine, GPU runtime or models are bundled.
plugins.author: Kiki

zh.description: 可选的 ComfyUI API 格式图像与视频工作流，使用你已运行的端点与已安装的模型。不附带引擎、GPU 运行环境或模型。

plugins.description: Official datasource workflows.
plugins.author: Moonshot AI

zh.description: 官方数据源工具：金融、宏观、企业、学术与法律数据，涵盖财报与行情序列。

compatibility.notes: Requires author-managed Kimi credentials and service entitlement; Kiki compatibility not revalidated. Author CDN may change; checksum pins inspected bytes.

plugins.description: Control your real browser from Kiki.
plugins.author: Moonshot AI

zh.description: 在 Kiki 中操作你真实的浏览器，沿用你已登录的会话。

compatibility.notes: Requires author browser extension and local daemon. Author CDN may change; checksum pins inspected bytes.

plugins.description: Planning, TDD, debugging, and delivery workflows for coding agents.

zh.description: 面向编码 agent 的规划、测试驱动开发、调试与交付流程。

plugins.author: Jesse Vincent

zh.description: 面向 Vercel 平台的技能、agent 与工程约定。

plugins.author: Vercel

compatibility.notes: Pinned author source. Preview imported contributions and unsupported diagnostics before enabling; no author scripts are run during catalog validation.

plugins.description: Modern web platform expertise, best practices, and browser compatibility data for coding agents, from the Google Chrome team.

zh.description: 来自 Google Chrome 团队的现代 Web 平台实践、最佳做法与浏览器兼容性数据。

plugins.author: Google Chrome
